text.en: Image search and question dialogs use settings-style groups and matching character illustrations. Conversation tasks remain available as the window narrows without adding a horizontal scrollbar.
text.zh-CN: 找图与提问弹窗采用与设置页一致的分组排版和角色插画；缩窄窗口时仍可查看会话任务，并避免底部出现横向滚动条。

text.en: Apple Silicon and Intel certificate-free macOS test packages can check and download updates through the isolated official channel, with installation requiring confirmation.
text.zh-CN: Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的无证书 macOS 测试包支持通过隔离的官方渠道检查和下载更新，安装仍需确认。

text.en: Check bundled plugin versions through a shared official update index, respect rate-limit recovery times, and retain the last successful check when updates cannot be checked.
text.zh-CN: 随包插件通过共享官方索引检查更新，遵守限流恢复时间；检查暂不可用时保留上次成功结果，并区分检查、下载和安装失败。

text.en: Show installation confirmation as soon as a download is ready, even after closing its progress window. Check running tasks after approval so Host preparation cannot hide the confirmation.
text.zh-CN: 下载就绪后立即显示安装确认，关闭过下载进度弹窗也能收到提示；用户批准后再检查运行任务，避免确认弹窗被应用服务的准备等待阻塞。

text.en: Reopen update progress while a download or file verification continues, and keep the installation confirmation accessible after the package is ready.
text.zh-CN: 修复下载或文件校验期间关闭弹窗后无法重新打开，以及安装包就绪后按钮可能持续转圈、无法再次打开安装确认的问题。
